description: You are the Finance Manager at a consulting firm responsible for processing month-end employee expenses. Three employees have individual draft expense entries in the system that need to be converted into expense reports and submitted for approval. Log in to Odoo at http://localhost:8069 with username admin and password admin. For each of the following employees, find their draft expense(s), create an expense report from those expenses, and submit the report: (1) Anita Oliver, (2) Sharlene Rhodes, (3) Paul Williams. After all three reports have been submitted, approve (validate) the expense report for Paul Williams only — his training expenses have been pre-authorized by the department head. Leave the other two reports in submitted state awaiting normal approval.
